notes.title: Version 1.07 & 1.08 update
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34043789/eac871dc92c5721f30fdfbf7c18bdbc7bd86585d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34043789/898dc1e2a3f61111c473f68fcaec5502b90f2f36.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34043789/aee4a150c726642d9b9a2f74d4cdefb516e55bda.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34043789/badd0e8e6e68a21d33929333ebb38d148c177fa6.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34043789/33cdbce436d03903fc08c199ef6d0d74828b38cd.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34043789/5d584fa84a17a77f1ecdbb62a057aa95c34aa0d2.png[/img][/url]

Hi! I've made a couple updates to Alien Field 3671

1. Now there's an option for slow mode. During the Mindware logo screen, a number is going to pop up 
in the bottom-left corner. If it is less than 4,400, then the player can change the game's speed in OPTION --> GAME SETTINGS.
Slow mode allows players to achieve extremely high scores. Give it a try!

2. Adjusted the hourglass effect. Now when the item is picked up, the "time recovery" animation is faster.

3. Added support for 64-bit scores. Also, high-scores that top 1 trillion now have their own leaderboard. 

4. In PC-8001 Arrange mode, the number of energy items has been adjusted. Now there are less drops in the later levels, which should make them more difficult.
